title: feat(rawfill): 96 covariant maps fill the two-cube from one site
science: Exact dynamical census, not a probe cell: all 512 cube-covariant occupancy predicates with f(empty)=0 run to a fixed point on the twelve-vertex two-cube from a 1-site seed. Theorem 2 gives N_fill=96 and N_empty=256 exactly (with N_empty=2^8 identified as exactly the f=0-on-one-unbalanced-axis subclass); Theorem 3 is a forcing negative - f_L1 fills with lock history (1,4,8,11,12) at halt tick 4 but is NOT the unique filler, with f_* (some unbalanced axis and no fully occupied axis) exhibited as a second filler having identical history, while Hamming parity does not fill. Also identifies the 10 rotation orbits of {0,1}^6 exactly with the axis-type triples (u,b,e).
verdict_pair: reverse=none face=none (no (reverse,face) pair stated; pre-verdict campaign phase)
